property.title: Property
property.description: Represents a real estate property listing.

description.description: A detailed description of the property.

price.description: The price of the property in XOF.

imageUrls.description: List of URLs for property images.

videoUrl.description: URL for a property video (e.g., YouTube).

tourUrl.description: URL for a virtual tour (e.g., Matterport).

documentUrls.description: List of URLs for property documents like cadastral plan, etc.

ownerId.description: The UID of the user who owns the listing.

validated.description: Whether the listing has been approved by an admin.

favoritedBy.description: List of user UIDs who have favorited this property.

userProfile.title: User Profile
userProfile.description: Represents a user's public profile in Firestore.

fcmToken.description: The user's Firebase Cloud Messaging token for push notifications.

agencyId.description: The ID of the agency this user belongs to, if any.

message.title: Message
message.description: Represents a message in a chat thread.

participants.description: Array containing the UIDs of both participants.

visitRequest.title: Visit Request
visitRequest.description: Represents a user's request to visit a property.

agencyProfile.title: Agency Profile
agencyProfile.description: Represents a real estate agency's profile.

ownerId.description: The UID of the user who owns the agency account.

agentIds.description: List of user UIDs who are agents for this agency, including the owner.

userDocument.title: User Document
userDocument.description: Represents a document submitted by a user for KYC verification.

userId.description: The UID of the user who submitted the document.

url.description: URL of the uploaded document in Firebase Storage.

appSettings.title: Application Settings
appSettings.description: Stores global settings for the application.

reservationFee.description: The symbolic reservation fee in XOF.

reservationFeePriceId.description: The Stripe Price ID for the reservation fee.

fcmVapidKey.description: The VAPID key for Firebase Cloud Messaging.

activityLog.title: Activity Log
activityLog.description: Records significant user actions within the application.

userId.description: The UID of the user who performed the action.

userDisplayName.description: The display name of the user at the time of action.

action.description: A short description of the action performed (e.g., 'user_login', 'property_create').

details.description: An object containing additional context about the action (e.g., { propertyId: 'xyz' }).

stripeCheckoutSession.title: Stripe Checkout Session
stripeCheckoutSession.description: The document written to Firestore to trigger the Stripe payment extension.

url.description: This is populated by the extension with the Stripe Checkout URL.

stripeProduct.title: Stripe Product
stripeProduct.description: A product synced from Stripe by the extension.

stripePrice.title: Stripe Price
stripePrice.description: A price synced from Stripe by the extension.

/settings/app.description: Stores global app settings. This is a single document.

/customers/{userId}/checkout_sessions/{s.description: Triggers the Stripe payment extension to create a checkout session.

/products/{productId}.description: Products synced from Stripe by the extension.

/products/{productId}/prices/{priceId}.description: Prices for a product, synced from Stripe.
